verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents remote control as a core feature, and a heavy daily user reports keyboard handling better than AnyDesk (no NumLock bug). However, that same user reports alt-tab problems from Linux to Windows, and nothing documents how mouse, keyboard, and scroll are injected on the host as native events. Missing for 10: documentation of native input-event injection per OS, any evidence on scroll and mouse fidelity, resolution of the special-key/alt-tab forwarding issues.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
